name: a11tech
description: A11 gives builders and their coding agents a backend-as-a-service on the fly so you never have to configure infra services again. Let's build, it'll be Astronomical.

interface.shortDescription: Build apps on the A11 backend
interface.longDescription: A11 is a backend for apps built with the @a11code/sdk package: end-user sign-in, files, structured data, key-value storage, AI, email, scheduled jobs, location and hosting. This plugin teaches your agent to read the A11 Cookbook, served one topic at a time with your project's A11 API key, before it writes A11 code. Install the a11 CLI and run `a11 init` in your project first: it stores the project's key, which the agent uses to read the Cookbook with the a11 CLI.
